name: Extract a scanned document and verify key facts
why: Pulls facts from a scan and checks each against the page with uncertain readings flagged, the same habit as the OCR-against-the-original prompt.

name: Data file clean-up loop
why: Cleans a messy export in rounds and saves the rules for next time, useful when a batch arrives as a bad export rather than documents.

name: Check supplier invoices before approval
why: Matches entered invoices to purchase orders and receipts after the bills import, the step a bookkeeper runs before anyone pays.

name: Recurring invoice exception review assistant
why: Checks each new invoice batch for duplicates, wrong sums and missing receipts and keeps an exception ledger, matching the exceptions-first way of working.

name: Prepare expenses for your bookkeeper
why: Sorts receipts into the bookkeeper's approved categories and lists missing receipts, for clients whose batch is expenses rather than supplier bills.

name: Expense report builder
why: Turns pasted receipts into an expense report with gaps listed, a small version of the documents-to-import-file skill.

name: Excel input form builder
why: Builds an Excel entry form with dropdowns and duplicate checks from field rules, the build step after the rules sheet.

name: Prepare an Excel input workbook for handover
why: Produces a checked input workbook and a guide from field rules, for handing a validated entry sheet to a team.

name: Prepare lab data for a checked import
why: Maps exports to a target schema with an import exception list, the same pre-import discipline applied to instrument data.

name: Check a spreadsheet before sharing the results
why: Traces totals back to source before anyone relies on a sheet, a companion to control totals and spot checks.

name: Set up a documentation system and write procedures that pass
why: Turns the one-page entry rules into a tested written procedure when a team needs more than a rules sheet.
